title: Layered perovskite structure inspection
description: Upload a published layered hybrid perovskite structure, confirm its identity, and explore symmetry-aware structure tools.

citations.short: Chakraborty et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 146 (2024), 34811–34821

guide.action: Upload data/structure/MC3I_PbI_100K.in using the upload box at the top of the workspace.
In Current Structure, confirm formula C32H88I24N8Pb4 and 156 atoms. Expand symmetry details and compare Aea2 (No. 41).
Inspect the symmetry controls; changes to tolerance can change the reported space group.

Choose Rotate Individual Molecules and a finite group from Molecule groups and names. Set direction 0 0 1 and angle 10 degrees; save its parameters, apply the rotation, and download the transformed CIF.
